solutionSql:
SELECT id, status
FROM shipment_scans_large
WHERE id < 5000
  AND status = 'delivered'
ORDER BY id DESC
LIMIT 1;
notes: Unchanged SQL. Revised text asks for one row and an ordering the primary key index can supply. Plan on all three datasets is Limit over Index Scan (Backward), with no Sort or Seq Scan. Result is id 4999 (delivered). The ticket states no column types, so columnsMatchTicket compares names only.
